Flipkart | Tea portfolio | 24 November 2026

TEAME & Celest
Commercial performance review

Senior management decision brief • Customer benchmark: 1 Oct 2025–24 Nov 2026 • Trading performance: 1 Oct–22 Nov 2026

Executive summary

The immediate priority is conversion recovery and cancellation control, not simply more traffic. Both brands show a sharp, sustained conversion decline in early November. The simultaneous pattern warrants a joint investigation with Flipkart before incremental advertising is scaled.

Gross sales₹41.58LOrder dashboard
Net sales₹36.24L87.2% retained
Cancellations₹5.09L12.2% of gross value
Conversion1.26%Funnel dashboard

Celest contributes 63.7% of net sales and leads conversion at 1.37% versus TEAME at 1.08%. TEAME has higher gross sales per unit in the funnel, but weaker click-to-cart performance. Celest has greater cancellation exposure.

Customer reach is close to vertical leaders (47.8K versus 49.1K), but East is the only zone above the benchmark. North and West together show a 5.4K customer gap. Female customer share trails leaders in every supplied segment, while repeat customers remain only 4.3% overall.

Management decisions requested

Authorize a cross-functional conversion incident review; request Flipkart's cancellation and competitor benchmark data in writing; prioritize North and West pilots after conversion stabilizes; and protect high-performing SKUs while validating anomalous listing metrics.

Evidence: 18 user-supplied dashboard screenshots, plus the user's account of Flipkart team's verbal feedback. The customer and sales periods differ and must not be combined into a single cohort.

Cancellations represent roughly 95% of the combined gross-to-net value gap. Celest has the higher unit cancellation rate and accounts for about 61.5% of cancelled value; TEAME has the higher cancellation value rate. Return rates are comparatively small on a gross-unit denominator.

Competitor context: According to feedback from the Flipkart team, cancellation levels in the similar tea category are broadly comparable to ours, while competitor return levels are reportedly higher. This is verbal feedback; numerical benchmarks have not been provided.

Recovery sensitivity

A 20% relative reduction in cancellation value could preserve approximately ₹1.02L in gross sales value over an equivalent period, before fees, returns and other offsets. Request buyer vs seller vs logistics cancellation reason codes, prepaid/COD split, SKU, pincode and fulfilment SLA.

Rates use rounded gross denominators from order view. Returns divided by delivered units would be a different rate; delivered units are unavailable. Brand cancellation totals and value sums differ slightly from overall due to display precision and/or scope.
Source: Batch 2, screenshots 6–8; user-reported Flipkart feedback.

Female share is below leaders in all nine views; the largest age gap is 45–100 (−7.9 pp), and the largest zone gap is East (−6.6 pp). Overall female share gap is −3.6 pp. At the same customer count, matching 32.8% would correspond to about 1,721 more female customers in the mix, not necessarily incremental customers.

Repeat share is 4.3% versus 4.1%, an advantage of only 0.2 pp. Test replenishment packs and platform-permitted remarketing; measure repeat purchasing by cohort rather than assume lifetime retention from this dashboard.

Management review / 08

State-wise sales and geographic expansion

What the map shows

West Bengal is the darkest visible state, consistent with strong eastern presence. Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Odisha are among the more prominent shaded states. Exact state-level figures are not shown; the legend ranges from 0 to 2,719 net units.

Where to test

North: Uttar Pradesh and Delhi/NCR as hypotheses for a pincode-level pilot.

West: Maharashtra and Gujarat, with metro-oriented assortment tests. West has 55.2% Tier 1 customer share versus 51.2% for leaders.

East: protect stock and delivery reliability in West Bengal and Odisha.

South: test selected cities after reviewing state-level unit economics.

The map reports net units for the shorter trading period; the zone dashboard reports customers over a longer period. No exact state ranking, revenue, market share or brand-level geographic split can be extracted from the map.
Source: Batch 2, screenshot 9; Batch 1, screenshots 2–5.

Flipkart team feedback | Competitive context

As communicated by the Flipkart team, cancellation and return levels in the similar tea category are broadly comparable to TEAME and Celest, with competitor returns reportedly on the higher side compared with ours. This is verbal feedback from Flipkart; exact competitor figures have not been supplied.
